edges.relation: Largest supplier of roof-mounted package AC units
edges.source_quote: Additionally, it holds a dominant position in the mobility application segment and is the largest supplier of roof-mounted package unit air conditioners to the Indian Railways.

Additionally, performance of the electronics division is also expected to remain healthy, supported by the recent acquisitions of Power-One Micro Systems Private Limited (Power-One) and Unitronics (1989) (R"G) Ltd (Unitronics) by AEIL’s subsidiary - ILJIN Electronics (India) Private Limited (ILJIN).
In the mobility applications segment, AEIL supplies Indian Railways and major metro coach manufacturers through its subsidiary, Sidwal Refrigeration.

key_risks: Seasonal RAC demand can cause revenue, profitability and working-capital fluctuations.
High dependence on imported raw materials and components exposes AEIL to foreign-exchange, import-dependency and price volatility.
Electronics capex and acquisitions could pressure returns until scale and integration benefits materialise.
